subject.title: [Feature]: Prefer Volta shim path over version-pinned Volta node path for macOS gateway LaunchAgent

question: Should OpenClaw support an accessible Volta shim as the managed gateway service fallback when no supported system Node is available?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes managed-service runtime policy from system-Node preference plus version-manager warning toward an explicit Volta-supported fallback.

options.title: Support Volta Shim Fallback
options.body: Allow `resolveStableNodePath` to map Volta tools/image Node paths to an accessible Volta shim only when no supported system Node is selected, with regression tests and live macOS LaunchAgent proof.

options.title: Keep System Node Policy
options.body: Reject the Volta fallback and close or retitle this as not planned, keeping docs and doctor warnings centered on system/Homebrew Node for managed services.

options.title: Defer To Broader Runtime Policy
options.body: Hold this issue until the broader version-manager warning/config question in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60612 is decided.

recommendation.title: Support Volta Shim Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow `resolveStableNodePath` to map Volta tools/image Node paths to an accessible Volta shim only when no supported system Node is selected, with regression tests and live macOS LaunchAgent proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice changes the runtime-selection policy introduced in `src/daemon/runtime-paths.ts`, where steipete has the clearest recent history.
